remainingLocalWork.item: STE-NXT-014 — End-of-service accrual as a provision (ADR-0010)
remainingLocalWork.details: Slice on top of cee546f9 (2026-10-10), built under the owner's delegation to decide: the recording mechanism is implemented with posting blocked until the accounting treatment is recorded and confirmed. Finance records the treatment named by a qualified accountant (measurement basis, accountant name and credential, liability provision account, expense account); a firm-wide Partner other than the recorder confirms it. Accruals are manual journals with purpose END_OF_SERVICE_ACCRUAL carrying an entered amount, method, inputs, calculation date and reason, through the existing journal maker and checker; corrections are reversing journals. The gate is enforced at draft, at posting and by a database trigger on firm_postings; treatment and basis rows are append-only. The platform computes no estimate. Also includes report certificate signing and evidence (migration 20261010203413_ReportCertificateSignatureEvidence, PEM signing credential source, signature verification endpoint and UI). Migration 20261010195818_FirmEndOfServiceAccruals; API /api/ui/finance/end-of-service; Angular /app/finance/end-of-service. Observed locally: Release build 0 errors; EF model drift none; OpenAPI contract regenerated; Angular production build passed. NOT RUN at the owner's instruction: automated tests were not run locally; the migrations have not been applied to any database. Still open: no treatment has been named by a qualified accountant or confirmed by the owner, so no accrual may be posted; the firm chart needs its provision and expense accounts; no browser E2E journey; the firm statements show the two accounts through the existing account-based reports without a dedicated provision line.

remainingLocalWork.item: ADR-0016 — Certificate signing of the final report (specification 4.4.1, 4.4.2)
remainingLocalWork.details: Working-tree slice on top of cee546f9 (2026-10-10), built on the owner's instruction to implement certificate signing. When ReportSigning:CertificatePath and ReportSigning:PrivateKeyPath are configured, the Partner's signing certificate-signs the final report PDF (SHA-256, whole document) in addition to the signature image and seal; bundle assembly re-verifies the report and certificate-signs the certified financial statements. ReportSigning:Required=true fails closed when no usable certificate is available and refuses an image-only report in the bundle. With no certificate configured the behaviour is unchanged (image only) and is labelled as such. Signature evidence columns on signature_applications via migration ReportCertificateSignatureEvidence; verifier endpoint GET /api/ui/deliverables/{id}/signature; Angular completion screen shows the mode and a signature check. No NuGet package was added (PDFsharp 6.2.4 already pinned). Observed locally: Release build 0 errors; EF model drift none; OpenAPI contract current; Domain tests ReportCertificateSigningTests and AuditDeliverablesTests 18/18 against PostgreSQL; Angular completion.spec.ts 12/12. NOT RUN: the full Domain, API and E2E suites and the full Angular suite; the added UiContractTests denial check. Still open: tested only with a throwaway self-signed certificate; the firm must obtain and install its own certificate and decide legal sufficiency; no trusted timestamp is embedded; readers show a self-issued signer as not trusted; engagement letters and other documents are not certificate-signed; the deployment guide (Wiki) does not yet describe the ReportSigning settings.
